description: A discrete round mound about 12 m across and up to c. 1.6 m high, isolated in a ditch-bounded pine plot between arable fields. No modern object stands on it in five orthophoto flights 2014-2025; the 2025 flight shows only a pale patch on its face. The 1900 Messtischblatt shows woodland here with no monument or extraction symbol.
alt_question: Could this be a spoil or clearance heap from digging the plot ditches or from building the nearby straight corridor, or a natural sand knoll from the dune area to the north, rather than a burial mound?

facts.statement: Local relief at the centre reaches 1.63 m (15 m window).
No registered Grabhügel within 300 m in the public Denkmalatlas Grabhügel snapshot.
The conifer block south-east of the point was clear-felled between the 2017 and 2020 flights.

limitations: Canopy hides the ground in most frames; the 2025 pale patch at the cross could not be resolved further at 20 cm; no older DGM1 epoch; Messtischblatt georeferencing unmeasured; only one Messtischblatt edition.

audit.reason: feature visible in the LiDAR panel/SLRM; tier A: discrete round mound
